Common.securityFaqQuestion: Is Refinedocs safe to use for confidential or sensitive files?
Common.securityFaqAnswer: Yes, Refinedocs is 100% secure. Unlike other online converters that upload your documents to external cloud servers, Refinedocs processes all files locally on your device inside your web browser. Using advanced client-side WebAssembly (WASM) and JavaScript, your files never leave your computer, ensuring absolute privacy and security for sensitive legal, financial, and personal data.
Common.loginFaqQuestion: Why do I need to log in to download my free files?
Common.loginFaqAnswer: Refinedocs is 100% free to use. We only ask for a quick, secure login before you download your files to protect our free browser-based tools from automated bot scraping, malicious scripts, and service abuse. This simple verification ensures high-speed availability and a smooth experience for real human users.

Help.title: Refinedocs Help & FAQ
Help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our open-source, private, client-side document suite.
Help.contactUs: Still have questions or want to contribute?

faqs.q1: Is Refinedocs completely free to use?
faqs.a1: Yes, Refinedocs is 100% free and open source under the MIT license. There are no subscriptions, paywalls, daily quotas, or locked features.
faqs.q2: Do I need an account or login to use Refinedocs?
faqs.a2: No. You never need an account, password, or login. You can open any tool and process files immediately with zero friction.
faqs.q3: Can I use Refinedocs for commercial or business work?
faqs.a3: Yes. Refinedocs is free for both personal and commercial document workflows without any royalties or licensing restrictions.
faqs.q4: Where is the Refinedocs source code hosted?
faqs.a4: The complete source code is publicly hosted on GitHub at https://github.com/lepatlamass/Refinedocs. You can inspect the code, open issues, or submit pull requests.
faqs.q5: Can I run Refinedocs locally on my own machine?
faqs.a5: Yes! Clone the repository from GitHub, install dependencies with "npm install", and run "npm run dev" to host your own offline local instance.
faqs.q6: Are my files uploaded to any servers or cloud storage?
faqs.a6: Never. All document and media processing happens 100% locally inside your web browser using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript. Files never leave your device.
faqs.q7: Does Refinedocs store or track my personal data?
faqs.a7: No. Refinedocs has no remote user database, no analytics trackers, no third-party cookies, and no telemetry.
faqs.q8: Can I use Refinedocs offline without an internet connection?
faqs.a8: Yes. Once the web application is loaded in your browser or running from your local build, all processing tools work completely offline.
faqs.q9: Is it safe to process confidential or sensitive legal documents?
faqs.a9: Yes. Because data never leaves your device or travels across the network, Refinedocs complies inherently with strict confidentiality and privacy standards.
faqs.q10: Are there any file size limits?
faqs.a10: There are no artificial limits imposed by Refinedocs. Processing capacity depends solely on your device's memory (RAM) and web browser resources.
faqs.q11: Does Refinedocs send data to external AI APIs?
faqs.a11: No. Refinedocs does not use external AI APIs or third-party cloud engines. All operations run directly on your hardware.
faqs.q12: I can't process my file in the browser
faqs.a12: If a file fails to process, aggressive browser extensions (such as ad blockers or script manipulators) may be interfering with WebAssembly. Try using an incognito window or disabling extensions.
faqs.q13: Where can I find the downloaded file?
faqs.a13: When processing completes and you click "Download", the resulting file is saved directly to your operating system's default Downloads folder.
faqs.q14: Why does my document layout look slightly different post-conversion?
faqs.a14: Document formatting fidelity depends on font availability. Using standard cross-platform fonts (such as Arial, Calibri, or Times New Roman) ensures optimal visual consistency.
faqs.q15: I need to compress a file further
faqs.a15: You can select stronger compression settings. However, files that already contain heavily compressed media cannot be further reduced without noticeable quality loss.
faqs.q16: My fonts changed after converting Office documents to PDF
faqs.a16: If non-standard proprietary fonts were used, system fallbacks are applied. To ensure pixel-perfect rendering, embed fonts in your document before converting.
faqs.a17: Refinedocs supports PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JPG/JPEG, PNG, WebP, SVG, HEIC, MP4, and GIF conversions, resizes, watermarks, and compressions.
faqs.q18: Can I merge or split PDF pages?
faqs.a18: PDF merge and split features are currently under active development and will be included in upcoming open-source releases.
